title: 30 Springbank, Saggart, Co. Dublin
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present this fantastic two-bedroom, one bathroom Semi Detached property to the market in the mature and well-established Springbank development, Saggart, Dublin 24.

This excellent home offers a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers or investors alike, with spacious accommodation of c. 75 sqm and the added benefit of a large garage to the side, providing excellent additional storage and potential for a variety of uses.

The location is next to none, with Saggart Village and Rathcoole Village both within easy reach, offering a wide array of local amenities including shops, cafés, restaurants, schools, leisure facilities and the picturesque Rathcoole Park. Citywest Shopping Centre is also close by, providing an extensive selection of shops, restaurants and everyday conveniences.

For commuters, the property benefits from excellent transport links, with numerous bus routes serving the surrounding area, the Red Line Luas within easy reach and convenient access to both the N7 and M50 motorway networks.

Bright and well-proportioned accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, living room, kitchen/dining area, two bedrooms and a main family bathroom. The property also benefits from gas fired central heating and the substantial side garage is a particularly attractive feature.

Additional Features:

c. 75 sqm

2 bed / 1 bath

Semi Detached

Large garage to the side

Gas fired central heating

Mature and well-established development

Excellent location

Close to Saggart & Rathcoole Villages

Citywest Shopping Centre nearby

Excellent transport links

Easy access to N7 & M50

Red Line Luas within easy reach

Ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers or investors


Viewing is highly advised to appreciate the potential this property has to offer.

Call Ray Cooke Auctioneers today on 01 908 9300 for further information or to arrange a viewing.
